title: Giants sign pair of defensive tackles to help fill Dexter Lawrence hole

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants sign pair of defensive tackles to help fill Dexter Lawrence hole
sources.description: The more notable addition is Shelby Harris, a 34-year-old with 89 career NFL starts. The Giants also signed Leki Fotu, a well-traveled player who has been with four teams in six years.
